CLAY MATERIALS, BORROWED PACING

The structure comes from your reference: one question per screen, a progress affordance with a way back, a large question headline, and a plain-weight line underneath explaining WHY the question is asked.

The materials stay clay. Option cards are inflated; the chosen one warms and lifts. The progress bar is a sunk channel with a coral rope pressed into it. Inputs sink, surfaces rise.

Nothing of the reference's identity is used — not its character, not its green, not its wordmark or display face. Those belong to them.

TWO PRIMARIES, ON PURPOSE

Onboarding advances on INK clay. Coral clay is reserved for logging a meal.

That is not a compromise — it means the coral button always says the same thing wherever you meet it, and setup never competes with the one action the product exists for.

It also matches what your app already does: the current onboarding CTA is black. I twice flagged that as drift. It was not drift.

THE CLAMP, EARNED

The reference explains why it asks for each piece of data. Your §2.1 rule says a floor that moves the number must always explain itself.

The target screen is where those meet: the raise is stated plainly, with the number it would have been, and the reason. No apology, no alarm colour, and a way to adjust the pace right underneath.

THE HERO IS THE RING

The journey moved off the dashboard onto its own Journey tab, where it already had a route. The dashboard shows today, not the whole arc.

The ring is the interactive object: the centre is a pressable puck that opens the log, and each macro tile below is tappable to filter the day. The mascot sits on the rim and reacts to logging, never to the number.

Depth encodes hierarchy, never status. Nothing gets deeper because a number got bigger.

WHERE WE ARE NOW

Rebuilt from the live app at 420x900 with its real tokens, so the comparison is honest rather than flattering.

The two floating controls sitting on the macro card are a measured overlap, not an opinion.
